articles.title: Ethereum's biggest 'sandwich' bot drained of $7.5 million in ironic exploit
articles.snippet: Blockaid said an attacker tricked Jaredfromsubway.eth into approving fake trading routes, then used those approvals to drain WETH, USDC and USDT.

articles.title: Live markets: Bitcoin under pressure as Saylor comments on STRC selloff
articles.snippet: About 20% of miners are now unprofitable, and publicly traded miners sold more than 32,000 bitcoin in the first quarter to cover operating costs, more than they offloaded in all of 2025.

articles.title: U.S. agencies seek stablecoin customer-ID rules akin to banks in new GENIUS Act pitch
articles.snippet: The Federal Reserve, Treasury and other regulators have issued a proposed rule that would set identification standards, and it's now open for public comments.

articles.title: Notorious ‘sandwich attack’ bot Jaredfromsubway.eth exploited for $7.5M
articles.snippet: Jaredfromsubway.eth was responsible for 70% of sandwich attacks on Ethereum between November 2024 and October 2025.

articles.title: Republican lawmaker proposes prediction markets insider trading ban, not including White House officials
articles.snippet: The bill did not specifically bar members of the US Congress from using the platforms or making sports bets, but prohibited policy wagers.
